content: SQLite has no date_trunc(); idiomatic bucketing uses strftime('%Y-%m-%d'|'%Y-%m'|'%Y', col) grouped as text (sorts correctly since ISO order but loses date-arithmetic typing). Week bucketing has no clean ISO-week truncation; must compute Monday-aligned week start manually via strftime('%w') weekday offset arithmetic, e.g. date(col, 'localtime', '-' || ((strftime('%w',col,'localtime')+6)%7) || ' days').
